instruction:
Reconstruct the final tower described by these successive speech messages from one trial. Later messages can correct earlier ones. A correction that depends on an unseen Builder state may remain ambiguous.

Message 1: All right, in a previous trial, you constructed using one blue brick and then two red column bricks stacked on top of it so that it looked like a capital letter L from your perspective. Now this construction is the same, but it's rotated 180 degrees so that it's placed on the front half. The blue brick goes on the front half of the 2x2 grid, and then the red column bricks are still stacked on top of each other, but this time on the right side of the blue brick so that it looks like a capital letter J from your perspective.
